notes: One isolated aircraft per run, constant altitude 300 m. No traffic interaction or capacity calculation.
Use the existing airport-access proxy route and 12 retained documented BS sites, not measured airborne link performance.
Initial offset zero for every adaptive envelope; compare against the same zero-offset no-change flight.
All grid points in the allowed envelope may be selected directly; intermediate positions are traversed continuously and are evaluated by the radio kernel.
Speed is the physical component along the smooth reference tangent. Total speed increases slightly during lateral motion.
Centerline is interpolated by a natural cubic at <=500 m control spacing; no path optimization or 8 km radius constraint is imposed.
Offset-coordinate velocity and acceleration limits are not a full-aircraft turning-performance envelope. Cartesian turning acceleration is reported separately.
Perfect static radio-map forecast, no future discretionary moves. Original C/R/F spacing-priority heuristic and exposure benefit gate retained.
Available-history exposure uses a singleton group; C/R/F time shares are not five-aircraft group policy or capacity.
Every static offset is an independent flight, not simultaneous traffic or a shared-terminal assignment.
Corridor only. No origin-to-lane connector, takeoff/landing, terrain, bandwidth load, antenna pattern, wind, energy model or emergency avoidance in this stage.
Radio distance extrapolation beyond 4 km and finite known-site inventory are explicitly reported; no calibrated aviation-safety claim.
